{"consolidated_memory":"CONFLICT LOOP ISSUES IN mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift — TWO SEPARATE OCCASIONS

**OCCASION 1: 2026-03-14**
- File: mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift (mobile sync side)
- Problem: conflict loop in the sync engine
- Reproduction: edit the same note on two devices offline
- Signal: two clients rewriting each other on every pass
- Trigger condition: occurred only for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call (PR #5931, branch fix/conflict-loop-1)
- Measured outcome: error rate dropped from 8.6 percent to under 5 per ten thousand
- Stack: Swift
- Test coverage: mobile/ios/SyncEngineTests.swift

**OCCASION 2: 2026-07-17**
- File: mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift (same area as occasion 1)
- Problem: conflict loop in the sync engine
- Reproduction: edit the same note on two devices offline
- Signal: two clients rewriting each other on every pass
- Trigger condition: occurred only when the input list came in empty
- Root cause: off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test around it (PR #8150, branch fix/conflict-loop-2)
- Measured outcome: job finished in 90 minutes instead of 4 hours

These were two distinct conflict loop bugs in the same component, discovered 4 months apart, with different root causes and different fixes."}
